The stones grant the benefits of a 1st- or 5th-level dwarf ancestry feat (or, for a dwarf, a co-investor's ancestry feat). The item record has no `choice`, so the player cannot even record which feat they took. The sibling artifact ancestral-embrace solves exactly this with a recorded-only open feat picker; mirror it. (The permanent status-spell link between investors is mutual awareness with no sheet statistic, and the physical changes are explicitly non-mechanical.)
